exclusion_reason: The bounded integer and FPU entry probe is implemented and active with shift, rotate, multiply, divide, setcc, string, and a 64-bit precision x87 subset, but the frozen FIX-002 instruction, flag, FPU, exception, self-modification, and memory suite cannot be assembled while BPTK-002 owns no frozen denominator, and full instruction coverage does not exist.
promotion_trigger: Promote when FIX-002 passes the pinned instruction, flag, FPU, exception, self-modification, and memory suite.
expected_failing_assertion: The complete i386 microprogram suite cannot execute to its frozen reference machine state while BPTK-002 owns no frozen denominator, and instruction outside the bounded subset stop as structured unsupported.
active_gate_evidence: Twenty-eight runtime check exercise the real bptk run surface and now cover the expanded bounded subset: shift and rotate count and carry, exact 32-bit multiply, structured divide_error, setcc comparison, deterministic rep movsb, deterministic x87 load-add-store double state, and the prior integer, flag, memory, rollback, and determinism coverage.
procedure: Run each microprogram with deterministic memory and instruction budget.
Compare registers, flags, exception, FPU, memory, and trace hash.
pass_criterion: All required instruction cases match the reference state.
Unsupported instruction produces a stable diagnostic rather than divergence.
